summary.result: In result regression models of cabbage can not be used in verification periods although those of garlic approximately predicted shipping amounts in verification periods.
summary.background: In this study the effect caused by limited storage lift of agricultural products for determining shipping amount can be analyzed by $l^{st}$ order autoregressive model based on cobweb theorem.
summary.method: Carrying capacity and auction price of upland-grown cabbage and garlic from 2000 to 2003 in wholesale markets were used for analysis.
